usage: music-tagger toc [-h] [-o OUT] [--log LOG] path

Read the TOC and disc ID from a rip directory's whipper log.

positional arguments:
  path           Rip directory containing the whipper .log.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -o, --out OUT  Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
  --log LOG      Whipper log to read.
